subject: general
question: 5 boys R, S, M, N and P are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only N is sitting between S and P. R is to the immediate left of S. R is at one of the end of the row. Who is sitting to the right of P?
solution:
Given: Five boys R, S, M, N and P are sitting in a row facing north.

R is at one of the ends and is to the immediate left of S.

Only N is sitting between S and P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0daa2bb73e1c7d81800eda8a5bf004032205ccaacc633bf21fddbb23deab834.png] 

Now, the person sitting to the right of P is M.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
